metrics.label: Family recovery
metrics.help: Generated proteins that belong to the requested protein family

metrics.label: Structure match
metrics.help: Mean TM-score of predicted structures against natural family members

metrics.label: Fold match
metrics.help: Generated proteins whose predicted structure matches a natural member (TM-score at least 0.5)

metrics.label: Confidence
metrics.help: Mean predicted structure confidence (pLDDT)

metrics.label: Follows request
metrics.help: Generated proteins that pass the specification gate

metrics.label: Quality filters
metrics.help: Generated proteins that pass the sequence filters

metrics.label: Passes all
metrics.help: Pass the gate, the filters and reach confidence 70 or more

metrics.label: Bare sequence
metrics.help: Generations that return a bare sequence instead of prose

metrics.label: Length ±10%
metrics.help: Sequences within 10% of the requested length

metrics.label: Hydrophobicity
metrics.help: Sequences matching the requested hydrophobicity level

metrics.label: Stability
metrics.help: Sequences matching the requested stability level

metrics.label: Aggregation
metrics.help: Sequences matching the requested aggregation level

metrics.label: Cysteine count
metrics.help: Sequences with exactly the requested number of cysteines

metrics.label: Net charge ±2
metrics.help: Sequences within 2 charge units of the requested net charge

metrics.label: Charge correlation
metrics.help: Correlation between requested and realized net charge

metrics.label: Transmembrane recall
metrics.help: Requested transmembrane helices that were produced

metrics.label: Transmembrane precision
metrics.help: Produced transmembrane helices that were requested

metrics.label: Transmembrane MCC
metrics.help: Matthews correlation for requested transmembrane helices

metrics.label: Signal peptide recall
metrics.help: Requested signal peptides that were produced

metrics.label: Signal peptide precision
metrics.help: Produced signal peptides that were requested

metrics.label: Signal peptide MCC
metrics.help: Matthews correlation for requested signal peptides

metrics.label: Exact Pfam recovery
metrics.help: Generations where the requested Pfam domain is detected

source: Aria paper (NeurIPS 2026). Control metrics: held-out evaluation of the supervised model. Tuning metrics: recorded per-round within-family evaluation, mean of two seeds where shown; round 0 is the supervised Aria base.
